These may look like classic flip-flops – but they're engineered with our all-day comfort tech.

Traditional flip-flop manufacturing means there’s not much scope for adding comfort to the style's slim, flat soles. But that’s where FitFlop comes in. This pair is biomechanically engineered to answer all the problems of classic flip-flops – while keeping the sleek, minimalist design you love. Featherlight iQushion™ midsoles are fitted with subtle pressure-diffusing pillows at the toe and heel (creating comfort without adding bulk), while an anatomically contoured footbed and thong straps that stretch further back along your foot make sure they stay close to your feet.
